messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The security audit flagged long-lived authentication gateway tokens. [valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-11]
- Authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour as of 2026-01-27. [decision; valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Team Atlas pinged the owners of billing-api on 2025-12-31. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Billing-api is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-03-25, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- Cinder observed at standup on 2026-04-17 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-17]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-10 that the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-10]
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- Boreal handed billing-api to Team Dune on 2026-03-25. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
- A partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-16]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]

Question: Which note corrected the recorded owner of auth-gateway, and when?
